items.text: That's mostly based on whether your pet's steal trick goes off or not, and unfortunately there isn't any way to boost proc chance on that. I'd say the best outfit for farming the quests would be one that boosts rare enemy as much as possible, and then has item drop in the remaining slots.

I like that it doesn't block story quests anymore, though that probably would have been more useful back before they took out random raid boss spawns. Used to be I would accidentally spawn a raid boss from some quest and then annoyingly have to clear it out before I could do more story, but now I usually only do it when I want to fight one.

IDK if you've gone through with any of the plans you already mentioned, but if you're not focused on PVP over the other stuff in this game I'd probably recommend putting the second chance skill on Kairi rather than the defense boost. It doesn't do anything in PVP, but a free extra turn without using a tank medal can make a huge difference in PVE and DBIV isn't usually enough to get that. DBII max isn't enough to do much of anything, unfortunately

Other than that, I'd say definitely  give a skill to Maleficent because +1000 strength is a decent trait, and use Cloud in any upright power slots for now.

I'd probably recommend evolving Maleficent right now since again, she has the best traits of your T8 medals. I don't recommend spending any Fantasia Mickeys until there's a guilt campaign, since otherwise you could be wasting a bunch of magic mirrors.
IIRC they are, so if steal doesn't proc that sucks but there's not much you can do about it.

items.title: [Guide] Analyzing the Dual Wield Roxas [EX] banner
items.text:
[Guide] Analyzing the Dual Wield Roxas [EX] banner
Since u/steventnorris hasn't posted a "Should I pull?" for this banner yet, I figured I'd try to do my own analysis rather than let the sub go without.

Dual Wield Roxas [EX] was voted one of the most popular medals on the KHUX Twitter, and as such he gets to evolve into a Supernova medal by using five 7\* copies of himself. In addition to unlocking his Supernova, this also raises his guilt to tier 9 and increases his base multiplier from 7.52-9.34 to a whopping 13.09-15.47, making him the strongest reverse power medal in the game right now--and he only needs high HP to max that multiplier out, which isn't difficult at all to obtain most of the time. His main drawback is that he only gives +7 power and reverse and -7 general and power, so you need to make sure you have at least a partial source of those buffs before you use him.

This banner is about as good as you could hope for when targeting a medal like this. On each pull, it gives out one 7\* copy of Dual Wield Roxas [EX], one trait medal for him, and 10 limited VIP coins. This makes him effectively a six mercy if you don't have any copies already, and it could be even lower for a lot of players since he's an older medal and has been available in pulls for a while now. Plus, there's a limited VIP coin board that has one trait medal for 5 coins, which is half of what trait medals usually cost, if you don't want to put those coins toward something else. So, *should you pull*?

**F2P**

Such low mercies aren't that common for F2P anymore, and reverse power is needed for all the 3-element Keyblades. If you don't already have strong reverse power medals such as KH III Master Xehanort or FFRK Sephiroth, this is definitely worth your jewels. It gets even better if you already have one or more 7\* copies of the medal, since you don't have to do all 6 pulls.

**F2Pish/C2P**

You can get 5-mercies more often if you purchase VIP, but none of those have guaranteed a T9 reverse power medal so you may still find yourself needing one of those--and that's where Dual Wield Roxas comes in. Since this banner doesn't interact with VIP at all the rest of the analysis is the same as for F2P

**P2P**

This is a medal with less utility but better multiplier than previous reverse power options. It's probably not worth it if you have those unless you already have several copies or you love the art, but if you missed them it's still a good idea to grab.
That's true. I think that if you have other gauge increasing medals it's probably not a big deal, but if you don't or you're running some other high hit count medals too it could become a problem.

If the traits on your KH3 Master Xehanort/SN Sephiroth are decent, I'd probably say to go for the Terra banner. Upright power isn't as useful as reverse power since there isn't a good slot in any of the tri-colored Keyblades, but it still could be needed in situations where your Keyblade options are constrained, and you already have a couple of reverse power options.
Chasing one trait is a bit of a fool's errand, so since you already have ground and air on KA20 I'd say go for TVA, assuming you can use an upright speed medal.

The biggest benefit from making medals SN+ is the strength increase, so I'd say that since KH3 YX, KH3 Riku, and KH3 Sora are more buffers that do decent damage than anything else, hold off on those unless they have amazing traits that will give them great DPS. Beyond that, just pick based on which fits best on your most used Keyblades and will be the biggest upgrade in its slot.

Yeah, those are some nice medals, I can see why you would have trouble choosing between them. I'd probably go for one of Sora & Riku or TVA first since they have the best traits, then HD Aqua when you get your next 5 Meow Wows since upright magic is always useful and she has decent traits too.

The new dancer ability is stealing the show, but I'm also happy to see the Acolyte's Archives getting updated with a new book that gives an imperil BSB draw and 3\* magicite as rewards. It's good to know they're still updating those as the game moves forward.
He's a powerful medal that fits on Starlight, Three Wishes and Fairy Stars. So pretty good.

Even if SN KHIII Kairi could be evolved into SN+, a medal like that shouldn't be a priority for evolving. Kairi's special attack has a relatively low bonus, meaning that most of the time she's really only going to be on your Keyblade for the buffs; even evolved she won't be doing a whole lot of damage. On the other hand, KA20 has a DPS oriented special attack with a good multiplier and a huge amount of strength, so when evolved he's going to do a lot of damage, even against high level enemies.

If you email support they *might* help you get your medals back, but they don't always. Rumor has it that they only will do that once, though I'm not really sure where that came from. That's pretty much your only chance, though.
She's a decently strong reverse magic medal, but not guaranteed and reverse magic doesn't have *that* many good slots. I might say to skip unless you really want Xion and GF Sora too.

Pretty sure one turn buffs and debuffs don't last into the second turn if you go last; that Aqua's effect does that seems strange but I guess it must be an artifact of how she's implemented.

PSM buffs work normally in PVP. The thread you saw was probably talking about medals that ignore targets' attributes, which normally get buffed by the attribute the target's weak to but behave like no attribute medals in PVP. Since no attribute special attacks don't get buffed by PSM, always effective ones don't either in PVP and therefore are pretty terrible.
They do work on the tier 9 supernova version, no need to worry. It would be pretty bad if they didn't because then those extra trait slots he gets from evolving would be pretty useless.
Extra attack + a bunch of strength if you want to use her in PVP; if you want her to help you in events and stuff then replace two of those strength traits  with ground and air defense down.
Status ability proc is by medal cast, so the only thing that gives you an extra chance is extra attack. As far as I know, the only thing that number of hits effects is enemy blue counters.

IIRC, Gaia's Blessing does Empower Earth, Dampen Earth, and gives a damage against Titan; pretty sure it can't be inherited either. I think you're supposed to be using it as a sub Magicite against Titan and a main Magicite against Ramuh.

SN Roxas has a higher multiplier than Pete and is also AOE instead of single target. Having a strong reverse power medal is important since it can be used in Starlight, Three Wishes, or Fairy Stars and they're the strongest Keyblades in the game. The banner guarantees a trait medal, a copy of Roxas, and limited VIP coins every pull, allowing you to evolve him after 6 pulls max.

So basically, it's a good deal for a great medal and you should definitly pull if you can afford it.
Glad to know I wasn't the only one to make that mistake. Managed to pull Sora and Riku both but I'd already gotten rid of my trait medals for them.

If you have 150 VIP coins and are in need of a good upright speed medal, then sure. I wouldn't say it's the best upright speed medal right now, but it's still pretty good and if you have the coins anyways it's effectively free.

While medals aren't generally considered "perfect trait" without extra attack, your traits are good enough that I wouldn't recommend chasing traits. Especially since extra attack is the rarest trait, so you're not likely to get it in two rolls. Plus the extra attack you get from pet training is better.

At the moment, there's only one banner that you can spend jewels on--the one with Anti-Aqua. It's pretty good for a new player as Anti-Aqua is super strong in PVP, Xion is the best buffer in the game, and Guardian Sora is decent as well. However, if you don't have 30,000 jewels (enough to pull 10 times on the banner) it's not worth pulling, as you probably won't get any of the featured medals if you don't make the 10 pull guarantee.

In the future, consider posting questions like this in the weekly megathred. That's what it's for, and they tend to get answered fairly quickly there.

items.title: Anti-Aqua Banner Analysis
items.text:
Anti-Aqua Banner Analysis
Watch out everyone! The Monster Sora killer, SN - KHIII Anti-Aqua, is here in a brand new banner alongside Sn-Guardian Form Sora and Supernova - HD Xion.

**The New Medal**

SN - KH III Anti-Aqua is clearly made for destroying Monster Sora in PVP, but she does have utility in PVE content as well. In terms of self-buffs, she does quite a bit—the only thing she really needs is general strength down, though her multiplier is lower than that of KH III Hades. Her supernova only does +250% guilt, which is similar to a lot of other recent medals but not as good as e.g. FFRK Sephiroth, and also does 4 hits without counter ignore, which could make her risky against enemies with blue counters. However, her real benefit is in PVP. The supernova has Monster Sora's 30% chance to ignore defense boost skills, and she also has a brand new buff that reflects all of the attacker's magic damage back at them. This is amazing in PVP when facing an enemy with magic medals, but it can also be great in PVE Colosseum as the reflected damage is raw and doesn't take into account your strength or the enemy's defense. It's not as good for events, though, as in general the damage done by event enemies isn't enough to make a difference.

**The Banner**

This banner guarantees 2 KHIII medals and a chance at Anti-Aqua, Guardian Form Sora, or Supernova Xion in 10 pulls for players who don't purchase VIP or 4 KHIII medals 5 pulls for those who do.

For those who are willing to pay as much as they need to do well in PVP, it's naturally a must pull. It's also not bad for F2P and newer players, since these people could likely use another strong buffer and a good upright speed medal in addition to the super-powerful Anti-Aqua. Unfortunately, occasional purchasers and lucky F2P are left cold. Since it's only a 1/3 chance to get Anti-Aqua from mercy, those who are already set for buffers and upright speed medals but aren't willing to spend as many jewels as they need to get her aren't likely to make out well from this deal.

Yeah, I've been wanting that for a while now too. Though since they just gave us the chance to buy draw tickets with our excess avatar coins, I'm hoping they know we want that and are thinking of something.
Yeah, there's an avatar board that gives one draw ticket for 1000 avatar coins up until the end of today. That's what those daily quests for avatar coins they've been having recently were about.
A shop that sold some upgrade material could be pretty nice. Maybe they could put a few things in with a limited quantity like low-tier skills that could help new players, blue fairies, etc.
